description: POST text (max 64 KB). Detects and redacts emails, phone numbers, Luhn-valid card numbers, SSNs, IBANs (mod 97), IPv4/IPv6 addresses, API keys, JWTs, private keys and password assignments. Returns redacted text, per-type counts and findings with offsets. Nothing stored. Costs $0.005 USDC per call via x402. Without payment, the call returns the x402 payment requirements; retry with an X-PAYMENT or PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header, or params._meta["x402/payment"].
name: pii_redact
title: Johto Data PII Redact
